    "testCaseID": "POS_TC_001",
    "title": "Positive Test: Successful LTE Attach and Detach of Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions",
    "category": "Positive Testing",
    "preconditions": [
      "Single LTE cell is activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off",
      "UE is stationary and placed under excellent LTE RSRP radio conditions as per Clause 4.6",
      "Test configuration parameters are defined and recorded"
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Connect to the test system using `SSH admin@<IP>` and enter CLI mode",
      "Configure and verify the test setup to ensure single cell scenario with one active UE",
      "Start log capture for call flow and signalling messages",
      "Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure",
      "Wait for successful attach confirmation by validating attach request and attach complete messages in logs",
      "Verify UE is attached to correct cell (e.g., PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN as per test configuration)",
      "Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure",
      "Wait for successful detach confirmation by validating detach request and detach accept messages in logs",
      "Stop and save test logs",
      "Repeat attach and detach steps for a total of 10 iterations"
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations",
      "Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations",
      "Attach latency values (min, average, max) are recorded and within expected range",
      "No connectivity issues during attach or detach",
      "Logs show correct signalling message flows as per 3GPP TS 23.401"
    ],
    "postConditions": [
      "Test logs saved for result reference and KPI analysis"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "SSH admin@<IP>"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Log analysis of attach and detach message flows",
      "Signal strength verification of LTE RSRP",
      "Cross-check UE cell attachment parameters"
    ]
  },
